article.summary_es: HOPE Empowerment and Development Zone Inc es una despensa de alimentos en Brooklyn, aparece en el mapa Food Help NYC de la ciudad. Abre los sábados de 12pm a 4pm, y la despensa funciona solo el tercer viernes del mes.
article.summary_en: HOPE Empowerment and Development Zone Inc is a food pantry in Brooklyn, listed on the City's Food Help NYC map. It is open Saturdays 12pm-4pm, and the pantry runs on the 3rd Friday only.
how_they_help_es: Es una despensa de alimentos según el mapa Food Help NYC de la ciudad.
Está ubicada en 369 New Lots Ave, Brooklyn, NY 11207.
Abre los sábados de 12pm a 4pm; la despensa es solo el tercer viernes del mes.
Puede llamar al (718) 568-7072 para preguntar antes de ir.
La lista no indica qué alimentos entrega ni si pide algún requisito.
how_they_help_en: It is a food pantry listed on the City's Food Help NYC map.
It is located at 369 New Lots Ave, Brooklyn, NY 11207.
It is open Saturdays 12pm-4pm; the pantry runs on the 3rd Friday only.
You can call (718) 568-7072 to ask before you go.
The listing does not say what food is given or if there are any requirements.
